comment: ANCHOR: DIP_LIST_20261106 — the dip list ranks stressed-group members by drawdown from the 20-session high on
daily closes (never the sparse Yahoo capture), shows forward P/E at the high only where the analyst history reaches it
(and says why when not), counts every quality-filter exclusion with its reason, and carries no sizing. The deep brief's
analyst facts read yahoo_analyst_targets_history, whose targets exist (analyst_consensus_history has none).
